# pve_metrics_server (Resource)

Manages an external metric server configuration (`/cluster/metrics/server/{id}`). One resource covers every PVE plugin type; `type` selects the plugin and each type-conditional attribute below names the types it applies to. Setting an attribute that does not belong to the configured type is rejected at plan time. Changing `id` or `type` forces recreation. Every mutation is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

variable "influx_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = "replace-with-influxdb-api-token"
}

# InfluxDB metric server using the http v2 API.
resource "pve_metrics_server" "influx" {
  id                 = "influx1"
  type               = "influxdb"
  server             = "influx.example.com"
  port               = 8089
  influxdb_proto     = "http"
  organization       = "pve"
  bucket             = "proxmox"
  token              = var.influx_token
  verify_certificate = true
}

# Graphite metric server (UDP transport).
resource "pve_metrics_server" "graphite" {
  id      = "graphite1"
  type    = "graphite"
  server  = "graphite.example.com"
  port    = 2003
  proto   = "udp"
  path    = "proxmox.mycluster"
  timeout = 1
  mtu     = 1500
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the metric server (PVE `pve-configid` format). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `port` (Number) Server network port. Must be between 1 and 65536 inclusive.
- `server` (String) Server DNS name or IP address (PVE `address` format).
- `type` (String) Plugin type of the metric server. Must be one of: `graphite`, `influxdb`, `opentelemetry`. Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `api_path_prefix` (String) An API path prefix inserted between `<host>:<port>/` and `/api2/`. Can be useful if the InfluxDB service runs behind a reverse proxy. Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`.
- `bucket` (String) The InfluxDB bucket/db. Only necessary when using the http v2 API. Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`.
- `disable` (Boolean) Flag to disable the plugin.
- `influxdb_proto` (String) InfluxDB transport protocol (PVE default: `udp`). Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`. Must be one of: `udp`, `http`, `https`.
- `max_body_size` (Number) InfluxDB max-body-size in bytes; requests are batched up to this size (PVE default: `25000000`). Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`. Must be 1 or greater.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for metrics transmission over UDP (PVE default: `1500`). Only applies to `type` = `graphite` or `influxdb`. Must be between 512 and 65536 inclusive.
- `organization` (String) The InfluxDB organization. Only necessary when using the http v2 API; has no meaning when using the v2 compatibility API. Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`.
- `otel_compression` (String) Compression algorithm for requests (PVE default: `gzip`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. Must be one of: `none`, `gzip`.
- `otel_headers` (String) Custom HTTP headers in JSON format, base64 encoded. Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. At most 1024 characters.
- `otel_max_body_size` (Number) Maximum request body size in bytes (PVE default: `10000000`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. Must be 1024 or greater.
- `otel_path` (String) OTLP endpoint path (PVE default: `/v1/metrics`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`.
- `otel_protocol` (String) HTTP protocol (PVE default: `https`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. Must be one of: `http`, `https`.
- `otel_resource_attributes` (String) Additional resource attributes as JSON, base64 encoded. Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. At most 1024 characters.
- `otel_timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds (PVE default: `5`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`. Must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.
- `otel_verify_ssl` (Boolean) Verify SSL certificates (PVE default: `true`). Only applies to `type` = `opentelemetry`.
- `path` (String) Root graphite path (for example `proxmox.mycluster.mykey`). Only applies to `type` = `graphite`.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to send graphite data (PVE default: `udp`). Only applies to `type` = `graphite`. Must be one of: `udp`, `tcp`.
- `timeout` (Number) Graphite TCP socket timeout in seconds (PVE default: `1`). Only applies to `type` = `graphite`. Must be 0 or greater.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The InfluxDB access token. Only necessary when using the http v2 API; if the v2 compatibility API is used, pass `user:password` instead. Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`.
- `verify_certificate` (Boolean) Set to false to disable certificate verification for https endpoints (PVE default: `true`). Only applies to `type` = `influxdb`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing metric server configuration by its identifier:
terraform import pve_metrics_server.influx influx1
```
